## Profiles API & knowledge UI conventions

## REST conventions for profiles endpoints

- Identity lives in the URL: `/profiles/knowledge/{profile_name}` + `project_id` as a **query** param on every endpoint. Never put `project_id`/`profile_name` in a request body.
- Bodies only describe the resource (`file_name`, `content`, `title`, `overwrite`).
- `PUT` = upsert (create or replace); `DELETE` takes the resource name as a query param (no DELETE body).
- FastAPI dependencies: one `Depends` chain validates project + profile (404) and permissions (403); FastAPI caches them per request. Do not re-resolve settings inside each handler.
- Request models: `ConfigDict(str_strip_whitespace=True)` + explicit `min_length`/`max_length` matching the tool limits (file name 500, content 200000, rule 4000 = `MAX_RULE_CHARS`).
- Storage `ValueError` → HTTP 400 with the message verbatim; do not string-sniff to build other codes.

## Profile knowledge UI

- `ProfileKnowledgePanel.vue` (rules/files tabs, budget bar, confirm modal) is mounted in `ProfileViewer.vue`; it reads `can_write` from the server and renders read-only with a lock hint otherwise.
- Rules are composed into `profile.content`, so any rule change must trigger a profile reload (panel emits `changed` → viewer emits `refresh`).

## WhatsApp / Channels board convention

All WhatsApp / external-channel work is tracked on board **Channels**, column **WhatsApp** (see `channels/whatsapp-bridge-architecture.md`).

Decisions already made (do not re-open):
- Official **WhatsApp Cloud API**, full duplex. The **Groups API is out of scope**: groups are created by the user in WhatsApp and codx-junior only stores group id/name + syncs messages.
- **Secrets live in global settings → `integrations[]`** (generic list, will also host Slack). Not env-var references, not in `.codx` project JSON, not in git.
- Identity: `CodxUser` carries a phone number (`wa_id`) and an `enabled` WhatsApp flag; a chat-level config lists which participants are synced.
- One group `Chat` ↔ one WhatsApp group/DM; mirrored messages tagged in `Message.meta_data["channel"]`.

## Kanban boards / sprints / task destinations

Kanban catalogue = `.codx/tasks/kanban.json` (`{version, boards: {name: {id,title,description,type,parent_id,columns[],active,last_update}}, tags}`) and is read/written through `ChatManager.load_kanban` / `save_kanban`.

- A board name IS the storage folder (`.codx/tasks/<board>/<column>/`) and is also stored in `Chat.board`; renaming must move the folder AND rewrite every task, deleting must not orphan tasks.
- A **sprint is a board with `type="sprint"`**; membership lives on the task (`Chat.sprints` holds sprint names). Deleting a sprint must clean `Chat.sprints` on tasks of other boards.
- Canonical task states come from `codx/junior/planning_manager.py` `STATUS_ORDER` — never hardcode a second list.
- Board/sprint/column CRUD lives in `codx.junior.tools.project_manager_tools` (`create_board`, `create_sprint`, `update_board`, `delete_board`, `create_column`, `delete_column`) and destination validation is shared via the public `validate_task_destination(chat_manager, board, column, sprints, status)`, used by `create_task` too. Tasks are always created through `TaskManager.create_task`.

## Identity: ids are canonical, names are labels

Every persisted element has an immutable `id` (UUID) and names/titles are only LABELS.

- Board/sprint: `board["id"]` in `.codx/tasks/kanban.json` (a sprint is a board with `type="sprint"`).
- Column: `column["id"]` inside its board entry.
- Chat/task: `Chat.id` (also the file name suffix).
- Message: `Message.id`, mirrored with the legacy `doc_id` (`id` is canonical).
- References on a chat: `Chat.kanban_id` (board id), `Chat.column_id`, `Chat.sprint_ids`
  (source of truth for sprint membership; `Chat.sprints` keeps display names).
- Storage folder is NOT the name: each board/column carries an immutable `folder`
  (`Chat.board_folder` / `Chat.column_folder` cache it). Renaming must only change the
  title — never…

## Profiles API & knowledge UI conventions

## REST conventions for profiles endpoints

- Identity lives in the URL: `/profiles/knowledge/{profile_name}` + `project_id` as a **query** param on every endpoint. Never put `project_id`/`profile_name` in a request body.
- Bodies only describe the resource (`file_name`, `content`, `title`, `overwrite`).
- `PUT` = upsert (create or replace); `DELETE` takes the resource name as a query param (no DELETE body).
- FastAPI dependencies: one `Depends` chain validates project + profile (404) and permissions (403); FastAPI caches them per request. Do not re-resolve settings inside each handler.
- Request models: `ConfigDict(str_strip_whitespace=True)` + explicit `min_length`/`max_length` matching the tool limits (file name 500, content 200000, rule 4000 = `MAX_RULE_CHARS`).
- Storage `ValueError` → HTTP 400 with the message verbatim; do not string-sniff to build other codes.

## Profile knowledge UI

- `ProfileKnowledgePanel.vue` (rules/files tabs, budget bar, confirm modal) is mounted in `ProfileViewer.vue`; it reads `can_write` from the server and renders read-only with a lock hint otherwise.
- Rules are composed into `profile.content`, so any rule change must trigger a profile reload (panel emits `changed` → viewer emits `refresh`).

## WhatsApp / Channels board convention

All WhatsApp / external-channel work is tracked on board **Channels**, column **WhatsApp** (see `channels/whatsapp-bridge-architecture.md`).

Decisions already made (do not re-open):

- **Secrets live in global settings → `integrations[]`** (generic list, will also host Slack). Not env-var references, not in `.codx` project JSON, not in git.

Kanban catalogue = `.codx/tasks/kanban.json` (`{version, boards: {name: {id,title,description,type,parent_id,columns[],active,last_update}}, tags}`) and is read/written through `ChatManager.load_kanban` / `save_kanban`.

request.description:
Re-creation of ownerless card `73d89c91-a2da-45cc-8bea-38edfed4dd3b` with a profile (option C of decision D1). The original ran with `profiles: []`, which makes an engine run return an empty assistant reply — the fix cannot be verified on an ownerless card.

## Root cause (already diagnosed, shift 5, 2026-11-19 — do not re-investigate)
- `codx/junior/autonomy/service.py:1159` creates the shift card with `profiles=[name]` only — the actor, no effort-bearing profile.
- `codx/junior/ai/smol/effort.py:379-404` `_resolve_base_policy` picks the tier by profile NAMES: `codx-junior-max` -> max, `codx-junior` -> agile, anything else -> `default_policy` (`:330`, `max_iterations = DEFAULT_MAX_ITERATIONS = 10`).
- `software_developer` matches no tier, so every shift got the plain-chat budget of 10 rounds — the exact stop message in the shift logs.
- `codx-junior.profile` and `codx-junior-max.profile` DO NOT EXIST in `codx/junior/profiles/` nor `.codx/profiles/`, so adding the agile profile name would be inert today.

## Fix landed (file level)
- `codx/junior/profiles/software_developer.profile` now carries `effort { max_iterations: 40, continue_on_tool_limit: true, continuations: 2, continuation_max_iterations: 10 }` (applied on top of the resolved tier by `effort.py:216-250` / `model/profile.py:55`).
- `.codx/profiles/software_developer.profile` does not exist, so the bundled file is the runtime source; the profile resolves (the actor runs shifts), therefore this file is what is loaded.
- Structural alternative ready to apply: `docs/patches/002-shift-harness-profile.patch` (adds the harness profile to the shift card) — blocked on the missing patch tool, and inert until `codx-junior.profile` exists.

## Steps
1. Restart/reload the API so the profile file is re-read (blocked: no shell tool — needs an operator or a `reload_profiles` path; check `project_read_file` on the profile manager if one exists).
2. Read the profile back through the runtime (e.g. `list_profiles` or the profiles API) and confirm the `effort` block is present.
3. Confirm a subsequent shift log of `software_developer` reports more than 10 rounds available, or an explicit effort tier, and that no shift stops with "Maximum tool rounds (10) exceeded" while the increment is open.
4. If the runtime still uses 10: the profile was cached — find the reload path, do not re-edit the file.

## Acceptance
A shift log showing > 10 rounds available (or a named effort tier) for this actor. Evidence: the profile file content + the shift log.

1. THE LOADER READS THE BUNDLED FILE LIVE (no seed copy matters)
   `codx/junior/profiles/profile_manager.py:151-200`:
   - `:152-159` `ProfileManager.__init__` sets `self.base_profiles_path = os.path.dirname(__file__)` — i.e. `codx/junior/profiles/`.

   - `:171-187` `_base_profile_path(name)` → checks `<dir>/<name>/<name>.profile` then `<dir>/<name>.profile` with `os.path.isfile`, per call.

   The patched file contains `"path": "/shared/codx-junior/.codx/profiles/software_developer.json"`. That path does not resolve from this sandbox (`File not found`) and is not consulted by `_base_profile_path`. It is descriptive metadata, not a redirection. My earlier worry (edit lands in a seed nobody reads) is refuted.

request.description:
Defect found by `software_developer` during shift 6 (2026-11-19), while verifying the round-cap fix. Independent from the card that fixed this actor's budget (`3d38db45`) — this one affects EVERY user of the harness, not just actors.

## The defect
`codx/junior/ai/smol/effort.py:52-54` defines
  AGILE_PROFILE = "codx-junior"
  MAX_PROFILE   = "codx-junior-max"
and `_resolve_base_policy` (`:379-404`) selects the agile/max tier from those profile NAMES only.

The pause message the user actually sees tells them exactly that:
  "Add the `codx-junior` profile for the agile tier, or `codx-junior-max` for the max tier, to the task's profiles — or mention `@codx-junior-max` in your message."
(`codx/junior/ai/smol/smol_agent.py:~4300-4328` and `codx/junior/autonomy/*` shift pause notice.)

But neither profile exists:
- `project_read_file("codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior.profile")` -> File not found
- `project_read_file("codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max.profile")` -> File not found
- `.codx/profiles/` (search_codx modules=["profiles"], 9 files) lists no `codx-junior*` profile either.

Consequence: adding the recommended profile is a no-op (`ProfileManager` cannot resolve the name), the tier falls back to `default_policy` (`effort.py:330`, `max_iterations = 10`, no continuation), and the user is told to do something that cannot work. This also makes `docs/patches/002-shift-harness-profile.patch` inert: it appends `AGILE_PROFILE` to shift cards, a name with no profile behind it.

## Steps
1. Confirm the read path once more (`ProfileManager.base_profiles()` globs `codx/junior/profiles/**/*.profile`, `profile_manager.py:152-169`) — if a project-level `.codx/profiles/codx-junior.profile` exists in another project, scope this card to "ship the bundled defaults".
2. Either
   a) ship `codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior.profile` and `codx-junior-max.profile` with only an `effort` block (`EffortValues`, `model/effort.py:278-333`, every field optional): agile => `{strategy: agile, max_iterations: 20, max_tool_calls: 8, continue_on_tool_limit: true, continuations: 2, continuation_max_iterations: 10}`; max => the same with a larger budget; or
   b) make the tier selectable WITHOUT a profile (e.g. read `effort.name` from global settings / a chat setting) and fix the pause message so it names a mechanism that exists.
   Prefer (a) for the minimum change, (b) for the honest UX; do not do both halves of the message and the code differently.
3. Add a regression test: for each name in `(AGILE_PROFILE, MAX_PROFILE)` assert a bundled profile resolves AND `effort_for([name]).name` is the matching tier. Tests live next to the existing effort tests (find them with `project_read_file(pattern="effort_for")` under `tests/`).
4. Only then consider applying `docs/patches/002-shift-harness-profile.patch`.

## Acceptance
`effort_for(["codx-junior"]).name == "agile"` and `effort_for(["codx-junior-max"]).name == "max"` with the profiles resolved from the bundled folder (test green), and the pause message references a name that resolves.

## Notes
- Not blocking: this actor's shifts already get 40 rounds from its own profile `effort` block (`codx/junior/profiles/software_developer.profile`), so `3d38db45` does not depend on this card.
- Blockers that apply: no shell tool (card `e816cc41`) and no patch tool (`76d97f04`) — this card is executable only as a new-file write (the two profiles are new files, which IS possible) plus a whole-file rewrite of `smol_agent.py` (5128 lines) which is NOT. Do step 2a + step 3 first; the message text can follow via patch.
